notes.title: New Patch Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

A new build has been released as of 10/24/22.

Changelog below:

-Painted a new ending image for Garudan. Current felt too underwhelming compared to the others. We wanted to get in a new one that felt more intimate. 
-New tank image added
-Added a UI prompt in the date scene for the kaiju menu to assist players
-Tuning on the first Mechachu fight. 
-Rewriting the advice section post Mechachu fight. 
-More script typo fixes.

Prior patch log as well:
-vsync toggle 
-everything coming up giga achievement fix
-tweaked parts of first dates
-few more typo fixes in script
-fixed a menu bug for incorrect button highlighting

notes.title: KAICHU IS OUT NOW!! It's Kaiju smooching time!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

This is just a quick update to let everyone know the time's finally come - Kaichu is now live, with a 15% discount!

For those waiting for a console version, those will be live in 2 hours, at 12PM EST / 9AM PST.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42461510/f1fbf5daf0afeb2b7952ff19175ad3f62bddd346.gif[/img]

As a reminder, if you enjoy the game, please leave a review!! It helps us a lot.

notes.title: WE HAVE A RELEASE DATE! Kaichu Releases September 7th Everywhere!!!
notes.content:
Hello all Kaiju Kissers!

We have good news - Kaichu will be releasing in only 3 weeks, on [b]September 7th[/b]! The game will be out for all systems. This means the same day, you can find the game here on Steam, as well as on Nintendo Switch, PS4/5, and Xbox! The game will be $9.99 or regional priced equivalent.

[previewyoutube=Myrfa941qVU;full][/previewyoutube]

The game will be available on PC & Xbox at 10AM EST (7AM PST), and then on Nintendo Switch & PS4/5 at 12pm EST (9AM PST). 

We hope you'll enjoy the game when it comes out!! We've brought you a few new screenshots as well below as a sneak preview:
